discord.title: Discord Rich Presence
discord.description: Show your friends what you're playing, requires Discord to be running.

videoFirst.title: Music videos first
videoFirst.description: Open video songs in Watch. Audio tracks still use the music player.

keepWatching.title: Keep watching view
keepWatching.description: Keep the watching layout on track changes and return from automatic Picture-in-Picture. Manual Picture-in-Picture stays open.

launchPlayback.resumeDescription: Restore the last queue and continue from the saved position with sound.
launchPlayback.pausedDescription: Restore the last queue and position without starting playback. This is the default.

playerHub.title: Open Player
playerHub.description: Return to either player and its current queue.
playerHub.dropTitle: Drop media files, a YouTube URL, or a video ID
playerHub.dropDescription: You will choose whether to import a supported item into your local library or play it now.

playerDrop.title: Dropped media
playerDrop.description: What should Flow do with this video?
playerDrop.imported: Added to Imported media in your library.
playerDrop.failed: The dropped video could not be resolved. Try again.
playerDrop.localUnsupported: Local-file playback and import need a dedicated local media path. YouTube URLs and video IDs work in this build.
playerDrop.unsupported: This item is not a supported YouTube URL, video ID, or media file.

flowImport.title: Flow playlist files (TIDAL import)
flowImport.description: Choose Flow playlist JSON files or ZIP archives. Playlists with existing names are skipped. Each playlist keeps its original track order.
flowImport.libraryFailed: Could not read the existing library. No playlists were saved. Try again.

reasons.invalidPlaylist: Failed: missing playlist name or videos array
reasons.emptyZip: Failed: ZIP contains no JSON files
reasons.saveFailed: Failed: library could not be saved

radio.geniusDescription: Endless playback with no automatic repeats. Enabling also turns autoplay on. Explicit replays and repeat modes remain available.
radio.exhausted: Station couldn’t continue — tap Retry station to try again.
radio.saveFailed: Could not save station. Try again.

sensory.title: Dollhouse Deviants Sensory Suite
sensory.dragControls: Drag to move. Double-click to reset position.

focus.title: Focus Mode
focus.description: Hide navigation and non-essential panels while watching or listening.

motion.title: Safe Motion
motion.description: Stop interface animations. New videos pause for photosensitivity consent. Footage itself is unchanged.

reducedFlash.title: Reduced Flash
reducedFlash.description: Constrain rapid color, beat, mirror, and MilkDrop effects.

font.title: Readable Font (ADHD/Dyslexia)
font.description: Use a readable font stack, double line height, and wider letter and word spacing.

contrast.title: High Contrast
contrast.description: Strengthen text and control contrast in dark or light mode.

colorBlind.title: Color Blind Support
colorBlind.description: Retheme the whole interface and reinforce state beyond color.
colorBlind.paletteDescription: Each palette keeps text and controls at WCAG AA contrast.

light.title: Light Theme
light.description: Use a light background with dark text. Dark remains the default.

simplified.title: Simplified View
simplified.description: Hide images, thumbnails, posters, and decorative artwork. Video playback remains available.

sensory.advisory: Music videos may contain flashing lights or strobing imagery. Playback is paused. Continue only when you are comfortable watching.
sensory.motionAdvisory: Safe Motion reduces interface movement; it cannot remove flashes from video footage. Every new video waits for your consent.
sensory.shortcuts: Both players: K play/pause, J/L or arrows seek, ↑/↓ volume, N/P next/previous, F fullscreen, I mini-player/PiP. Tab and Enter operate controls. In the audio player, I toggles the dock; audio has no video PiP window.

related.title: Related Songs
related.snapshot: Snapshot for {{name}} · close and reopen to refresh
related.error: Related tracks could not load. Close and reopen to retry.
related.empty: No related tracks outside your library and queue.

crossfade.title: Musical crossfade
crossfade.description: Off keeps hard cuts. Automatic advance and Next/Previous use an equal-power overlap when enabled. Seeking never starts a fade. Video Watch hand-offs keep the separate video player.
crossfade.metadata: Known tempo and phrase metadata align transitions; incompatible keys use a short clean fade. With no tempo metadata, the selected duration applies. Existing per-track normalization and an overlap peak limiter protect the mix.

visualizer.title: Audio visualizers
visualizer.livePreview: Dockable live preview — every change applies immediately.
visualizer.enabledDesc: Shows the selected visualizer on the active player.
visualizer.advisory: Sensory advisory: audio-reactive visuals and MilkDrop presets can flash or strobe. Safe Motion uses a static frame. Focus Mode and Simplified View hide visuals.
visualizer.acknowledge: I understand that animated visuals may flash
visualizer.acknowledgeDesc: Required before animated visualizers begin sampling audio.
visualizer.suiteHidden: Your sensory mode hides the visualizer. Its settings stay saved.
visualizer.reducedFlashDesc: Limits FPS, beat response, color cycling, kaleidoscope, and MilkDrop effects.
visualizer.familyDesc: Changes the geometry used to draw the audio.
visualizer.modeDesc: Places the visualizer inline, floating, or fullscreen.
visualizer.mirrorDesc: Repeats geometry without increasing analyser sampling.
visualizer.directionDesc: Sets where shapes begin and move across the canvas.
visualizer.fpsDesc: Caps redraw frequency to protect slower GPUs.
visualizer.sensitivityDesc: Raises or lowers how strongly audio moves shapes.
visualizer.smoothingDesc: Blends adjacent audio frames for gentler movement.
visualizer.densityDesc: Controls how many bars, points, or particles render.
visualizer.falloffDesc: Controls how slowly peaks settle after a hit.
visualizer.beatDesc: Controls how much bass pulses the visualizer.
visualizer.colorModelDesc: Build a foreground gradient over an independent background.
visualizer.familyOverrideDesc: Keeps a separate color setup for this family.
visualizer.foregroundDesc: Sets the base color used by MilkDrop and fallbacks.
visualizer.backgroundDesc: Sets the canvas behind every visualizer shape.
visualizer.gradientDirectionDesc: Rotates the foreground gradient around the canvas.
visualizer.gradientStopsDesc: Use one to ten ordered colors in the foreground.
visualizer.stopDesc: Position controls where this color enters the gradient.
visualizer.colorCycleDesc: Hue rotation flows continuously; sequence mode steps colors.
visualizer.colorCycleReduced: Reduced Flash keeps color cycling off.
visualizer.cycleSpeedDesc: Longer cycles change color more gradually.
visualizer.savePresetDesc: Stores the complete current setup in this profile.
visualizer.presetLibraryDesc: Twelve tuned starting points grouped by intensity.
visualizer.category_energetic_desc: Faster response with controlled beat emphasis.
visualizer.category_experimental_desc: Complex mirrors, particles, and feedback effects.
visualizer.category_custom_desc: Named presets saved locally in this profile.
visualizer.flashWarningDesc: Review the risk before applying this preset.
visualizer.flashWarningReduced: Reduced Flash will constrain this preset before applying it.
visualizer.portablePresetsDesc: Export or import your named presets as one local file.
visualizer.importFailed: That .ddviz file could not be imported.
visualizer.waiting: Waiting for the real audio analyser
visualizer.idle: Visualizer sleeping · audio is paused or silent
visualizer.milkdropPresetDesc: Selects a bundled MIT Butterchurn preset grouped by author.
visualizer.milkdropWarning: MilkDrop presets may flash or strobe
visualizer.milkdropWarningDesc: Review this warning before starting or changing animated feedback.
